Répartition des raccourcis clavier entre: How keyboard shortcuts are split between the desktop and Windows when a Windows window is active.
Touche Super envoyée à Windows: Send the Super key to Windows
Dans une fenêtre Windows, la touche Supe: In a Windows window, the Super key opens the Windows Start menu and its shortcuts (Super+E, Super+V…) are sent to Windows. Off: the Super key stays with the Linux desktop.
Dans une fenêtre Windows, Alt+Tab passe: In a Windows window, Alt+Tab switches between Windows windows. Off: Alt+Tab is handled by the desktop and cycles through all windows.
Le bureau demande votre autorisation la: The desktop asks for your permission the first time, for each Windows window. Super+Escape gives the shortcuts back to the desktop at any time. Applies to the next Windows window you activate.
Ces raccourcis ne sont jamais envoyés à: Never sent to Windows. When Windows receives system shortcuts, the first press returns shortcuts to the desktop and the second triggers the shortcut.
Raccourci non reconnu. Exemple de format: Shortcut not recognized. Example of a valid format: <Super>Left
Aucun raccourci réservé: No shortcut kept for the desktop
